                                                                                                                                                                                              Port Plus®, Obayashi's next-generation training facility, was completed in March 2022 in Yokohama City as Japan's first

                                                                                                                                                                                              promotion, innovation, wellness, and sustainability for the facility as “a place to foster the future of knowledge.”

       headquartered in Asia and North America are helping build life-enriching social infrastructure
       through their business activities with a strong environmental and social consciousness.
       We introduce independent ESG projects of our Group companies in Asia—
